scripts.postinstall: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.predev: npm run env:init --prefix backend && npm run env:init --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d --wait && npm run db:migrate --prefix backend && npm run db:seed --prefix backend && concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
